posts.author: BobH
posts.content_md:
I agree it's a shame the words "hologram" and "holographic" have been usurped by those in marketing and advertising to mean so many non-holographic things, and that the general public has eaten it all up with a spoon. I think many of the problems with ebay listings, however, are evidence of the success of embossed security hologram marketers at spreading the meme that a holographic sticker somehow adds value to a product. So now we have all those listings for sports memorabilia, secured with a hologram and listed in the ad, cluttering up the search results for anyone looking for a real hologram. 

I wish ebay would increase the number of filtering words for the searches. Maybe add a new category for holograms. That would help anyone searching for the real thing to sort it out.

posts.author: Diode Holographer
posts.content_md:
Actually, I'm afraid that at least some of the items you mention and claim to be "NOT-Hologram" indeed ARE holograms. 

Not all holograms are 3 dimensional pictures. Many times you see an item that is "prismatic" it is an embossed hologram of a HOE (Holographic Optical Element) of a *Diffraction Grating*. For example, the prismatic security stickers you find on CD and DVD cases are in fact holograms. 

I can understand the reason for your quest. It can be quite hard to find exactly what you're looking for on places like ebay. However, don't think you really have a legitamate complaint with many of these items.
